name: orb_momentum_v29
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: NIFTY's first 30 minutes (09:15-09:45) establishes a broader overnight-reconciliation range than the classic 20-minute ORB — FII desks take an additional 10 minutes to absorb SGX Nifty divergences and macro data released post-open. When VIX is elevated above 15, option market-makers widen quotes and pull back delta-hedging flows that normally dampen ORB breakouts; institutional directional desks face reduced head-on resistance and their TWAP algo must keep buying through the supply ceiling, producing 25-45 spot point continuation legs. The VIX > 15 condition is the critical differentiator: in calm markets (VIX < 15), ORB breakouts are routinely faded by option sellers harvesting gamma; in elevated-VIX sessions, those sellers step back, letting momentum persist long enough to capture at 5-second resolution with a 30-120 second hold.

indicators.name: orb_high
indicators.purpose: Fixed 30-minute time window (09:15-09:45 = 360 bars at 5s). NOT scaled — the opening range is a real-time market-structure window, not a rolling lookback. Extended to 30 min from the classic 20 min because the original strategy's 15-min bar timeframe implies participants are using a longer calibration period; the extra 10 minutes captures delayed macro data reactions that a 20-minute window misses.

indicators.name: orb_low
indicators.purpose: Mirror of orb_high for bearish breakdowns. Same 30-minute window rationale. Locked at 09:45 and held constant for the rest of the session.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(typical_price * volume) / cumsum(volume), reset per day
indicators.purpose: Cumulative session measure — no lookback scaling needed. Confirms the net directional bias of institutional flow since open. ORB breakout above VWAP = institutional net buyers; below VWAP breakout = net sellers. Critical as secondary confirmation that the breakout aligns with session-level order flow.

indicators.name: persist_3bar
indicators.purpose: Required at 5s resolution to filter sub-15-second spike-and-retrace patterns common in NIFTY index microstructure. Original 15-min bars naturally suppressed these transients. 15-second persistence (3 bars) is the minimum duration that distinguishes genuine institutional breakout flow from algorithmic noise.

indicators.name: vol_ratio
indicators.purpose: Rolling 15-minute volume mean (180 bars × 5s) adapted from original's SMA(volume, 30) on 1-min bars (= 30 min). Set to 15 min rather than 30 min because at 5s resolution the most relevant volume baseline is intraday-recent (avoid stale pre-breakout lows). Confirms breakout is accompanied by genuine demand surge, not a thin-market spike.

indicators.name: vix_close
indicators.formula: India VIX 5s close aligned via join_asof to spot bars
indicators.purpose: Key regime filter absent in v22. VIX > 15 screens for sessions where option market-maker gamma hedging is sufficiently active that breakouts face reduced mean-reversion resistance. The original strategy's explicit VIX > 15 filter encodes this market structure insight — low VIX implies option sellers are willing to aggressively fade ORB breakouts, so we avoid those sessions.

conditions: close > orb_high for 3 consecutive bars (persist_3bar above)
close > vwap (net institutional buying since open)
vix_close > 15.0 (elevated VIX — option sellers stepping back)
buy_ce.confirmation: 3-bar persistence above 30-min ORB high + VWAP alignment + VIX regime

conditions: close < orb_low for 3 consecutive bars (persist_3bar below)
close < vwap (net institutional selling since open)
vix_close > 15.0 (elevated VIX — put option sellers stepping back)
buy_pe.confirmation: 3-bar persistence below 30-min ORB low + VWAP alignment + VIX regime

exit.stop_rationale: 5 option points = ~10 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5. In elevated-VIX sessions (VIX > 15), NIFTY ORB throwbacks before continuation average 8-12 spot points; 10 pts covers the typical throwback without exiting a valid trade, but a retracement beyond 10 pts signals the breakout has failed and inverted.
exit.target_rationale: 9 option points = ~18 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5. VIX-elevated ORB breakouts on NIFTY extend 25-45 spot points in the first leg (vs 20-35 pts in calm markets); 18 pts captures the lower half of this distribution conservatively. Risk:reward = 1:1.8.
exit.eod_rule: flatten at 14:30 IST — ORB continuation exhausts by early afternoon; late-session entries in elevated-VIX sessions carry gap-risk at thin liquidity

filters.vix_filter: vix > 15.0 — core regime condition; below 15 option sellers aggressively fade ORB moves
filters.time_filter: 09:45-14:30 IST only; allow 30-min ORB to form, cut off at 14:30 to avoid late-session low-volume fakeouts
filters.volume_filter: volume > 1.2x rolling 15-min average as breakout confirmation
filters.trend_filter: VWAP — price must be on correct side of session VWAP for the breakout direction
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution, no spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — VIX regime filter provides some robustness vs pure ORB systems; edge decays if VIX structurally compresses below 12 for extended periods (as in 2017-2019 US markets)

adaptation_notes: Original trades Nifty200 top-50-volume stocks on 15-min bars, holding 30-60 minutes. Conversion adapts to NIFTY index with five key changes: (1) Universe collapsed to single NIFTY index — index ORBs are cleaner because cross-sectional noise cancels out and institutional flow aggregates at index level. (2) Opening range extended to 30 real-time minutes (360 bars at 5s) from v22's 20-min ORB — the 15-min bar timeframe in the original implies participants requiring longer calibration before committing; 30-min ORB is a documented durable variant. (3) VIX > 15 filter added from original's explicit condition — the critical differentiator from v22 (which has no VIX filter); this condition gates the strategy to sessions where gamma sellers step back. (4) ATR-based stops replaced by fixed option premium points (5 stop, 9 target) calibrated to VIX-elevated NIFTY ORB extension of 25-45 spot points. (5) Volume lookback set to 180 bars (15 min) vs v22's 120 bars (10 min) — matches the longer ORB formation window. Session entry at 09:45 (vs v22's 09:35) to match the extended ORB window.
weaknesses: VIX > 15 filter reduces trade frequency — many low-VIX sessions produce zero entries
30-min ORB extends into the session, reducing the trading window vs 20-min ORB
3-bar persistence adds 15-second lag; fast VIX-driven breakouts can run 10+ pts before entry
On high-VIX gap-up/down days, the ORB range may be too wide for reliable breakout continuation
NIFTY ORB false breakouts persist even with VIX filter — partially mitigated but not eliminated
